result.scope: One matched full-model optimizer update; 24 ranks, accumulation3, 72 exposures. Includes update warmup; excludes model loading and checkpoint save. Not a long-run or quality comparison.

provenance_note: Raw results copied without changing historical values; backup_source_sha256 identifies source at backup time, not a claim that earlier runs used every later change. outputs/ and weights remain local.
